sql:
SELECT e.cost 
FROM expense e 
JOIN event ev ON e.link_to_budget = (
    SELECT b.budget_id 
    FROM budget b 
    WHERE b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
)
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Posters' AND ev.event_name = 'September Speaker'
